protocol.preprocessing: source-train-only median imputation, signed log1p, source-train StandardScaler
protocol.amendment: v2.1 before any final scores: batch-one invariant INT8 inference and source-only recalibration of previously trained legacy weights
protocol.class_weight: inverse source training frequency times benign cost; mean training weight normalized to one
protocol.student: existing MLP: 12 -> 64 ReLU Dropout(0.1) -> 32 ReLU -> 2; identical supervised and KD capacity
protocol.loss: training-class-weighted hard CE and per-row soft KL; T=3, hard fraction=0.25
protocol.early_stopping: source calibration weighted hard CE, max20, patience4; same calibration also selects operating points
protocol.quantization: PyTorch dynamic qint8 Linear; scripted row-wise execution fixes activation calibration to one record regardless of outer batch; operating point calibrated on source only
protocol.historical: same legacy pool sample size and grouped source/final split as previous revision; target grouped half previously examined, diagnostic only
protocol.common: fixed capture-disjoint train/calibration/final roles; per-source train/cal cap30000; final never fitted
protocol.inference: single CPU thread, 30 warmups, 200 timed model-only batch1 calls and 50 preprocessing+model calls
protocol.comparison: A/C legacy paired; B/D common paired; cross-track contrasts are descriptive, not capture-matched causal effects
protocol.success: report both external recall and FPR; reducing alarms by predicting everything benign is not a successful IDS
